title: Engineer Wey Dey Work for Ground Wit Customers
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Di Work

Di Engineer wey dey work for ground wit customers (FDE) dey stand for di middle, between Kyber main platform and di places wey our customers dey use am run dia operations.

You go dey work hand-in-hand wit di client teams to develop, adjust and deploy Kyber for real-life conditions: you go turn our SDK into solution wey fit each customer hardware, network and di latency wey dem fit tolerate.

Dis work no be only development and e no be only support. Na you go carry di whole process for di customer side: you go find out wetin dem need, design how di integration go be, write di code, join am wit di customer stack, and make sure say di deployment stand gidigba for production.

If anything scatter for field when only 2 ms remain, na you be di person wey sabi our platform inside-out and di customer environment well-well reach to fix am.

You go dey work inside di customer teams so una fit quickly bring solutions wey fit dem exactly, for systems wey complex and wey dey change every time.

Wetin You Go Dey Do :

  • Join di customer teams to understand dia machines, networks and di wahala wey dem dey face for operations, then turn all of dem into clear technical requirements
  • Design, build and deploy integrations wey fit each customer, on top di Kyber SDK and di transport layer
  • Tune di pipelines from beginning reach end make dem meet strict real-time targets (latency budget, frame budget, jitter, packet loss for QUIC)
  • Join Kyber wit di customer hardware and software — actuators, sensors, video streams and control stacks
  • Find and solve wahala for deployments wey dey run live, most times when latency and reliability no get space at all
  • Carry wetin customers need and wetin you learn for field go back to di main product; work wit di platform and electronics teams on top di architecture
  • Write technical documents, integration guides and reference deployments
  • Do code review for senior level and make sure say engineering quality dey high for all di work wey customers go see

Skills Wey You Must Get

  • You sabi how Windows dey work inside and im ecosystems well-well
  • You understand synchronization mechanisms, memory management and how to handle errors for system level + You know clearly di boundary between user-mode and kernel-mode, plus how to manage user sessions
  • You don use your hand work wit Windows debugging and analysis tools
  • Programming Languages : C / C++ / Rust / X86/x64
  • Tools & Environment : Visual Studio and Windows toolchains, GitLab and di way team dey develop togeda

Who You Be

  • You get 3–10 years experience for software development, and you don ship plenty systems go production
  • You sabi Rust, C or assembly well — and you fit read and debug for all di three
  • You understand real-time and low-latency systems well (latency budget, frame budget, scheduling, back-pressure)
  • You don work wit networked or streaming systems; you know transport protocols (QUIC, UDP, TCP) and di gain and loss wey each one get
  • E dey sweet you to work directly wit customers: to gather requirements, define di work, and explain technical decisions clear-clear
  • You dey carry work like your own — e no dey worry you to take problem from requirement wey no clear reach system wey dey work for deployment
  • You ready to travel go customer sites and work for where operations dey happen

Skills Wey Go Add Value (No Be By Force) :

  • Experience for robotics, drones, cars wey dey drive demself, or teleoperation
  • Background for video/media pipelines or signal processing (if you don work near VLC/FFmpeg, e go add value)
  • You sabi SDR, embedded systems or how to integrate hardware for PCB level
  • You don contribute to open-source projects
  • You don work before as engineer wey dey for ground wit customers, customer engineer, field engineer or solutions architect

How Di Interview Go Take Waka

  1. First Call (15 Minutes) : Small gist about wetin dey motivate you, whether you fit di role, and we go answer di questions you get wey no be technical.
  2. Two Technical/Product Interview (1 Hour Each) : We go dig deep into how you dey take solve problems, wit our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  3. Meet Di Team : Relaxed session to make sure say you and our culture go gel well.

Wetin We Dey Offer You

  • Projects wey get plenty technical work and wey go challenge your brain
  • Environment wey dey respect real engineering skill and wey focus on tech (no useless meetings or reports)
  • Projects wey go challenge your brain, for di front line of how to control machines from far place for real time
  • Plenty freedom to take technical decisions
